_help: Single source of truth for downloads and resources. Only status 'live' entries render. fulfillment 'file' uses 'path' (relative to the repo root, e.g. downloads/name.xlsx); fulfillment 'url' uses 'url' (for example a Gumroad link). To make a template paid later, change only 'price' and 'fulfillment' (and 'url'). 'alsoAs' lists optional extra formats of the same template.
